Strategy 05: UT Bot and Supertrend, hourly, long only

#BoughtPriceSoldPriceSharesNet P&L (Rs)Return
Signals are worked out from the closed hourly candle; each order fills at the open of the next candle, a signal on the day's last candle at 09:15 the next day. P&L is after charges and slippage. Click a trade to zoom to it.
